name: quickmove-tracker
description: QuickMove Relocation Operations Tracker — root build orchestration for single-service deploy (Railway/Render). Not used for local dev — run frontend and backend separately, see README.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
